def compute_feature(df):
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    # Compute bar midpoint using high and low to reduce microstructure noise
    midpoint = (df['high'] + df['low']) / 2.0

    # 20-bar lagged midpoint (strictly backward-looking)
    window = 20
    lagged_midpoint = midpoint.shift(window)

    # Guard against zero denominator by clipping
    lagged_midpoint_safe = lagged_midpoint.where(
        lagged_midpoint.abs() > 1e-8, other=np.nan
    )

    # Percentage change from 20 bars ago to current midpoint
    momentum = (midpoint - lagged_midpoint_safe) / lagged_midpoint_safe.abs()

    # Return series aligned with df index
    momentum.name = 'high_low_momentum_20bar'
    return momentum

def compute_feature(df):
    import numpy as np
    import pandas as pd

    window = 180  # 30 minutes at 10s resolution

    # Current bar high-low range
    hl_range = (df['high'] - df['low']).clip(lower=1e-8)

    # Rolling mean of range over lookback window
    rolling_mean_range = hl_range.rolling(window, min_periods=1).mean().clip(lower=1e-8)

    # Ratio of current range to rolling mean range
    ratio = hl_range / rolling_mean_range

    return ratio
